title: Noise-heavy log dump — one load-bearing FATAL line + a version mismatch buried in retries
source: synthetic; bulky tool_result the model must compress hard while keeping the buried needles
slice:
### assistant
Checking why the api-gateway deploy is crash-looping.
[tool_use Bash] {"command":"kubectl logs deploy/api-gateway --tail=400"}
### user
[tool_result] INFO booting api-gateway
INFO loading config from /etc/app/config.yaml
INFO connected to redis at 10.0.2.7:6379
WARN slow query (412ms) on orders
INFO cache warm
INFO ready
WARN retry 1
WARN retry 2
FATAL: image pull failed: ghcr.io/acme/api-gateway:v2.3.1 not found (manifest unknown)
WARN backoff 2s
WARN retry 3
WARN backoff 4s
WARN retry 4
WARN backoff 8s
INFO scheduler requeued pod
WARN retry 5
WARN backoff 16s
(… 200 more identical retry/backoff lines …)
### assistant
The tag v2.3.1 was never pushed to the registry. The CI publish step is gated on a release tag; we tagged v2.3.0 last week but the Helm chart still references v2.3.1.
### user
Right — fix it: bump the chart in deploy/values.yaml back to v2.3.0, or cut and push the v2.3.1 release tag so CI publishes the image.
